culture.text: Tiny team: about 22 people, set up as a partnership in 2018, headquartered in Greenbelt, Maryland, US.
Runs the FiNext Conference, an events platform about AI, mobile payments and fintech in finance.
Staff mostly work in business development, project management, sales and marketing.
